title: Light Signaling in Plants: Phytochromes and Blue-Light Receptors
method: Actual saved HTML teaching-prose paragraphs counted using Unicode lexical tokens; other article text separately counted excluding markup, SVG title/desc, buttons, CSS/JS. Final candidate changes robots metadata only after saved draft QA.

comparator.comparison: Comparable narrative depth and progressive mechanistic exposition; 4.A.10 was not published at audit time.

scientific_checks: Official revised CSIR syllabus Unit 4.A plant light signaling, separate CSIR and archived MP SET syllabus alignment; detailed physiology reserved for Unit 6.

Pr/Pfr nomenclature and bidirectional spectral overlap, thermal reversion, phyA VLFR/HIR versus phyB LFR, nuclear transport, PIF regulation and COP1/SPA-HY5 sign, FAD-cryptochrome and FMN-LOV phototropin chemistry, directional signaling and evidence limits reviewed.
Original historical and hypothetical experiments explicitly distinguished; final review improved distractors and explanatory alternatives in analytical items.

arithmetic_checks.scope: Photon energy and flux, fluence, fractions, germination differences, photostationary state, time constants, dark decay, receptor abundance, HY5 turnover and practice calculations.

academic_self_review.method: Separate internal editorial review, not external peer review. Full assigned coverage and coherent depth; one point deducted for source-access and model limitations, one for experimental evidence limitations, one for lack of externally calibrated questions, two for untested interactive/browser accessibility.

limitations: Bibliographic records and accessible material checked; not every source full text or textbook chapter independently accessed.
MP SET alignment uses archived 2024 syllabus copy; current official MPPSC version not independently verified.
Static source checks only; no interactive browser, mobile or comprehensive accessibility tests.
Deployment and live chapter verification separate from commit.
